messages:
maria: Heads-up — I opened this thread to sync on the audit-log immutability + KMS plan for customer-facing exports. Need quick feedback on schema additions and retention/archival strategy before we lock the PR.

dan: +1. Which parts are proposed as immutable vs mutable metadata? I want to understand what customers can redact or request deletion for.

maria: Plan is: event body immutable once written (WORM window), but metadata tags (ingest_label, processed_by) can be appended. Deletion requests will create a tombstone event instead of removing bytes.

alex: For immutability we should rely on S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) + Glacier Deep Archive for cost. Also we need manifests to prove chain integrity — similar to a content-addressed logchain.

julie: Agree. For customer-facing validation we propose adding a signed_digest on exported bundles and per-event canonical_id so customers can verify no tampering.

maria: Sketch of schema addition:
```json
{
  "schema_version": "2",
  "canonical_event_id": "sha256:<hex>",
  "event": { ... },
  "signed_digest": "base64_hmac_sha256",
  "encryption": {
    "envelope_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redwood/audit-archive",
    "cipher": "AES-GCM-256"
  }
}
```

dan: If we put KMS alias in the export, need to be careful not to leak customer key ARNs for Private deploys. Use alias name only, not full ARN for hosted.

alex: For key rotation: envelope encryption. DEKs are rotated per export batch; DEKs wrapped with current CMK. Keep historical wrapped keys in the manifest so archived bundles remain decryptable after rotation.

security-bot: vuln-alert: CVE-2025-XXXX — reported issue with HMAC libs; in-progress patch recommended. Jul 15 timeline.

julie: Good catch @security-bot. We'll switch to libsodium wrapper for signing and schedule an ASAP patch. Also document migration for old canonical signatures.

maria: Retention: default 7 years for enterprise customers, 1 year for self-serve. Legal hold flows will mark object-lock retention infinite until release. Need design for legal-hold tagging API.

sre_lead: From ops: storing 7 years in Glacier is fine, but rehydration SLOs need alignment: rehydrates may take hours. For incident playbooks, we should keep a hot window (90 days) in S3 Standard-IA for quick access.

alex: Proposal: tiering policy — 90 days hot, 18 months warm, rest cold (Glacier). Manifests per-bundle include tiering_index and keystore pointers.

dan: RBAC: We need a new role 'audit.reader' and scoped policies so customers can request read-only exports without exposing internal org logs. Also add an 'audit.admin' for retention/hold operations restricted to legal ops.

julie: For customer validation, we'll expose a verification tool (CLI) that takes bundle + manifest and verifies signatures, schema_version, and object locks. Should be in rust/cross-compile for on-prem customers.

maria: Action items:
- @alex: update manifest spec to include wrapped_key_history and tiering_index (due EOD Fri).
- @julie: add signing lib migration plan + CLI spec (due Tue).
- @dan: draft RBAC policy snippets and legal-hold API (due Wed).
- @security-bot: track HMAC vuln and confirm mitigation timeline.

alex: noted. I'll add a minimal manifest example to the PR. Quick sample manifest snippet:
```text
manifest_version: 1
bundle_id: bj-20250712-0001
wrapped_keys:
  - dek_id: dek-20250712-1
    wrapped_by: alias/redwood/audit-archive
    wrapped_blob: <base64>
objects:
  - key: logs/2025/07/12/part-0001.gz
    canonical_event_count: 1200
    lock_mode: GOVERNANCE
```

maria: Nice. One question: how do we prove immutability to customers who demand WORM-certified proof? Do we need third-party notarization?

julie: We can provide an end-to-end proof bundle: signed manifest + S3 Object Lock headers + KMS audit logs (CloudTrail entries) + periodic notarization checkpoint (optional add-on). That should satisfy most compliance teams.

dan: Legal hold workflow detail: API should return a hold_token and expiration; holds are idempotent. Also record event in our internal audit log when hold set/released.

sre_lead: Ops note: ensure lifecycle policies do not conflict with object-lock and legal holds — object-lock takes precedence but we should add policy validations in the console to prevent misconfig.

maria: Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge the schema PR after @alex and @julie updates. :thumbsup:

dan: :thumbsup:

julie: :+1:

security-bot: vuln-alert-status: HMAC lib upgraded in staging build 20250715-2.

maria: Closing loop — I'll post the PR link once updated and tag legal for review on the hold API.
